LanguageData.Lumen_Overlight_Rule: A separate gold ring of plant-capable light that follows the daily sun-lamp schedule. Plants keep their usual light, temperature and growing needs. The fixture's ordinary green light is always on.
LanguageData.Lumen_Overlight_SolarPerDayDesc: Spent evenly while the light is lit.
LanguageData.Lumen_Overlight_Darklight: Darklight: always on; plant-capable light disabled
